name: HRas proto-oncogene, GTPase

function.text: HRAS encodes a small GTPase that couples growth-factor receptor activity to downstream signaling pathways regulating cell proliferation, differentiation, and survival.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Costello syndrome (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Thymoma; Ectomesenchymoma; Pheochromocytoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
